answer: Sea Limited reported **net income of US$1,610.9 million (approximately US$1.6 billion)** for FY2025, up significantly from US$447.8 million in FY2024. Of this, **US$1,578.1 million was attributable to Sea Limited's ordinary shareholders** (after deducting US$32.7 million attributable to non-controlling interests) [Sea, FY2025, p.F-11].
